title: AtlasBenchmarkRecord
description: Records a benchmark result together with its full configuration. Scores from different setups are never compared as equals, publisher results are never merged with independent ones, and downloads/likes are never quality evidence. Specification version 0.1.0.

model.description: Model variant identifier this result belongs to.

quantization.description: Exact quant tested; a base-model score never stands in for a quantized variant.

hardware.description: Full hardware context is mandatory for atlas_verified hardware measurements; publisher claims may legitimately omit fields.

reasoning_mode.description: Reasoning on/off and budget when applicable; never compared across modes without disclosure.

score_unit.description: Unit is part of the result; unitless comparison across benchmarks is forbidden.

source.description: Reference to the source record (source.schema.json) this result comes from.

benchmark_origin.description: A publisher benchmark is not an independent benchmark. Origins are never averaged together without a published method.
